policy: Ordered per-seed, per-participant mechanics; no histogram or outcome-distribution substitution. Missing evidence is incomplete, not a match.
exact: ordered native instruction and six-slot queues
ordered queue consumption, gates and clearing
animation names, combination/body state and tag metadata

archived_reference.scope: Stage 1 observable mechanics, including resulting movement. The archived trace did not record root displacement or collision internals; it cannot close full stage 2 readiness alone.

full.scope: Same-source rendered/headless mechanics with per-tick CPU root motion and collision results, in addition to archived-reference comparison.

physics_step.scope: CollisionTest flags observed in MoveAlgo::tryMove only; direct NPC ground corrections and mobsi moves are not reclassified as probes. grounded means native movement_state==Run. Every NPC tick is covered: movealgo_tick=false explicitly records a native branch that skipped MoveAlgo, zero applied root/requested motion and collision_scope=none; actual position/yaw changes are still recorded.

interpretation: Time is relative to episode_start. Actor lifetime IDs are mapped to start actor/target roles; absolute game clocks and IDs are not expected to match.
34 ms is one fixed 30 Hz step; 2 cm and 0.5 degrees bound trajectory drift. This does not permit different choices, damage or terminal outcomes.
Animation windows are engine guard predicates. Censored intervals remain censored; an unexercised guard is reported as unexercised.

Native source nondeterminism may make a historical trace diverge. Report the first ordered mismatch, reproduce it with the archived binary/same-source render, and isolate the cause; never loosen limits after a failed measurement.
